resources.string: the tiling desktop opens apps as windows through a small helper that runs with android\'s debugging rights. setting it up takes a minute, once.
the tiling desktop needs android 13 or newer
the pairing code is typed into a notification: android takes the code back as soon as its settings are left
without it, android 17 hides this phone\'s own debugging port from the launcher
in About phone, tap Build number seven times (samsung: under Software information · xiaomi: tap OS version instead)
connect to wi-fi. then, in Developer options, switch on Wireless debugging and allow it on this network
Wireless debugging is off: switch it on in Developer options, and the helper starts

1. in Developer options, tap the words Wireless debugging (not its switch)\n2. tap Pair device with pairing code, and note the six digits\n3. a notification asks for them: open it and type them in. stay in android\'s settings until then: leaving them cancels the code
found the pairing dialog · type its code into the notification
that code was not accepted · tap Pair device with pairing code again for a new one
this phone no longer accepts the launcher\'s key · pair once more
pairing did not work · tap Pair device with pairing code again
the helper was started and did not answer
the helper could not be started
android did not switch them on. in Accessibility → Downloaded apps, switch on Tiling desktop shortcuts (if greyed out: App info → ⋮ → Allow restricted settings)
all set · connect a hardware keyboard and the desktop starts
all set · the desktop is ready

USB debugging is now on as well: it keeps the helper running when wi-fi drops. after a restart of the phone the launcher switches Wireless debugging on for a moment, on a wi-fi you allowed, to start the helper again.
after a restart of the phone, switch Wireless debugging on once and the helper starts again
in Wireless debugging, tap Pair device with pairing code
the six digits android is showing
tap Pair device with pairing code again for a new one
connect a hardware keyboard and the desktop starts
paired, but the window helper did not start
